Babylon Sky Garden

Condominium in Rawai
HomeSaleBabylon Sky Garden

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A completed seven-storey building of 41 apartments on a site of about 1,875 sqm on Soi Laem Ka Yai in Rawai. The developer describes it as a one-bedroom building with a short walk to Rawai Beach and sea views from many units.

One-bedroom apartments are advertised at around 53-56 sqm; the developer quotes 51-57 sqm. The communal pool and kids pool, a reception lobby, parking at close to one space per unit, a lift in each building, and 24-hour security with CCTV serve the residents.

The same developer built the neighbouring Babylon Sky Garden 2 and the Babylon Pool Villas hotel.

Babylon Sky Garden: key facts

  • Babylon Sky Garden is a boutique condominium in Rawai, Phuket, developed by Billfishing Phuket Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 1 bedroom, 53–56 sqm.

  • Advertised starting price: ฿4,650,000.

  • Nearby, according to the project data: Laem Ka Beach (600 m, straight line); Chalong Hospital (5.1 km, straight line); Dibuk Hospital (10.8 km, straight line); Makro (2.0 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Billfishing Phuket in our catalogue: Babylon Sky Garden 2.
